exact_variant: Official model card: S1-mini is distilled from S1; S1-mini 0.5B, full S1 4B. Assessed 2026-10-10.
reported_weight_size: not published/found; the official Hugging Face file listing is gated and exposes no sizes.
text_description_voice_design: Not established for local S1 Mini. Its card documents emotion/tone/special markers, not creating a new speaker identity from only natural-language description. Fish Audio's separate hosted Voice Design API accepts natural-language prompts but does not identify S1 Mini as its backing model. Thus not a documented fit for text-only custom voice design.
reference_audio_cloning: Separate from text-only design. Fish Speech documents zero-/few-shot generation using a 10–30-second vocal reference; hosted Fish Audio TTS docs also document reference-audio cloning. Sources do not establish a S1 Mini-specific local cloning workflow. This is cloning, not text-only voice design.
language_and_control_coverage: Official S1 card lists 13 languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Dutch, Italian, Polish, Portuguese. It documents emotion markers, tone controls (hurried, shouting, screaming, whispering, soft), and vocal-event markers (laughing, sobbing, sighing, panting, etc.). These govern delivery, not speaker-description-only design.
code_license: Current official repository states codebase and associated weights use Fish Audio Research License (updated 2026-03-07); research/non-commercial use is granted subject to terms, while commercial use needs a separate written license. S1 Mini model card separately labels weights CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 and requires non-commercial-only agreement. The repo-wide and model-specific terms differ; the opened sources do not establish a distinct S1 Mini-specific code license. Do not infer permissive code rights; seek clarification. Older v1.5.0 tag says Apache for code but predates S1 Mini and is not model-specific evidence.
weights_license: S1 Mini card specifies CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 and gated access requires agreement to non-commercial-only use. Current repo-wide Research License also claims to cover associated weights and requires separate commercial authorization. As official statements differ, do not assume commercial rights; seek written clarification/license.
cpu_memory_and_runtime_evidence: No S1 Mini-specific CPU/RAM/latency/core/GPU requirement or benchmark found. Current install guide and pyproject describe current S2/repository setup, not measured S1 Mini: Python 3.12 recipe, Linux/WSL, CPU optional install/container; guide states 24GB GPU memory for GPU inference. Current pyproject requires Python >=3.10, so Python 3.12.3 fits that current repo constraint, but this does not prove S1 Mini compatibility or speed. For 8 cores, 23 GiB RAM, no NVIDIA GPU and 54 GiB disk, fit/runtime cannot be established because checkpoint bytes and CPU/RAM benchmarks are not published/found. No install/download performed.
quality_ranking_evidence: Artificial Analysis Provider Voice Arena, observed 2026-10-10: S1 Mini displayed rank 60 (overlapping rank range 52–71), Elo 1041, 95% CI ±20, 1,681 samples, 8 voices. Method is blind listener votes comparing pairs generated from same text, ranked by Elo; it compares providers' native voices, not locally text-designed voices. Official S1 card/blog report S1-mini English Seed-TTS Eval WER 0.011, CER 0.005, speaker distance 0.380 (automatic; GPT-4o transcription and named speaker-distance system); S1 flagship comparison: 0.008, 0.004, 0.332. Metrics are not an independent human rank. The company's #1 subjective Arena claim refers to S1, not specifically S1 Mini.
github_popularity_evidence: HF model card showed 2,092 downloads last month when checked 2026-10-10; popularity proxy only, not quality. No current date-stamped GitHub star count verified or used.
integration_notes: Official repo provides implementation but current main/docs focus on S2. HF marks S1 inference=false and gates checkpoint files. Hosted TTS docs list `s1` but not `s1-mini`, and support API/Python/JavaScript. Voice Design endpoint is separately hosted and does not establish local S1 Mini integration. Local S1 Mini API/runtime and text-only design remain unverified.
caveats: Requested cutoff is 2026-10-10; leaderboard/download figures are observations on that date, and leaderboard is live.
Do not conflate style tags, reference-audio cloning, or hosted Voice Design with local S1 Mini text-only voice design.
Checkpoint access is gated; exact weight bytes unverified.
S1 Mini card weight license and repo-wide Research License statements differ; commercial use should not be assumed permitted.
Current install/runtime evidence is for current repository/S2, not S1 Mini-specific resource measurements.
